accepted_scope.scope: Exact positive owned buying-power release actually credited by Polymarket US collateral return on independently existing eligible mutually exclusive short positions or lower-ranked-long versus higher-ranked-short directional positions, only when the released buying power has an independently justified positive after-cost use and every incremental risk and cost is included.
accepted_scope.why_scoped_only: The sources prove deterministic portfolio-margin mechanisms but not account enablement, owned qualifying positions, a positive use of released buying power, persistence, fees, exit liquidity, or after-cost profit. The release cannot be reused in the generating event and must be returned before an offsetting position can close.

exit_and_cost_boundaries: Collateral return is buying-power relief, not cash income, payout, or reduced actual risk.
The positions must exist independently; the overlay may not justify opening either leg.
Freed buying power may be deployed only into different events, not the event generating the release.
Closing an offsetting position requires returning released collateral and the close is rejected if buying power is insufficient.
Hypothetical collateral return from a proposed new order is excluded from pre-order buying-power checks.
Exact account enablement, owned release receipt, fee treatment, position lineage, use, unwind ordering, opportunity value, persistence, tax, and every incremental cost remain unproved.
